title: Single-Block Lattice Transfer
body_html:
Single-Block Lattice Transfer

Let \(w\in\operatorname{Hom}_D(V,V')\) satisfy \(M(w)\in\Gamma+\mathbf g_{x,r+}\) for a single positive-depth block of depth \(r=2s\). Define \[ L'_t=wL_{t+s}. \] Then \(L'\) is self-dual, its jumps are the jumps of \(L\) shifted by \(-s\), and it is the unique self-dual lattice function with \(w\in (L\otimes L')_s\).
proof_html:
Extraction

The proof computes dual lattices using \(w^\ast w=M(w)\), the relation \(\Gamma L_{t+s}=L_{t-s}\), and self-duality of \(L\). Uniqueness follows by comparing a candidate lattice function with \(wL_{t+s}\) and then dualizing the inclusion.
